result.topic_en: Sparse notes on the intersection of the old and new equator, with a sketch of a spherical triangle and formulas for transforming variables of the form $(\eta-\alpha)/(1+\alpha'\eta)$, presumably in the context of a change of coordinates on the sphere.
result.transcription:
Der alte und neue Äquator schneiden sich

[sketch of a spherical triangle]

$\sqrt{\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}}$

[-?-]

$\eta_1\eta_1'=1$

$cc'$. $\frac{\eta-\alpha}{1+\alpha'\eta}$ $\frac{\eta'-\alpha'}{1+\alpha\eta'}$

$\eta$

methods.what: Relation between a variable and its conjugate counterpart (reciprocal condition, e.g. antipodal/equator points under stereographic coordinates)
Linear fractional (Möbius) transformation of the complex coordinate and its conjugate, corresponding to a rotation of the sphere (change of equator)
Square-root ratio of transformation parameter and its conjugate

items.quote: Der alte und neue Äquator schneiden sich
items.english: The old and the new equator intersect.
